ambiguity.detail: Alexander's return from the dead or exile is assumed, but details of his disappearance are absent.

verdict.cliffhanger_line: Because we know who he is.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A presumed-dead rightful heir returns to crash a wedding and reclaim his title from a usurper.
verdict.why_it_works: Delivers the ultimate 'return of the true king' trope with guards turning on the villain in real-time.
